documents.title: KSDMA Public Alert - Flood and Heavy Rain Safety
documents.text: Flood and heavy-rain safety: Follow current warnings and instructions issued by the competent local authorities. Do not cross rivers or flowing water, and do not bathe, swim, wash, or allow children to play in rivers, storm water, or the sea during dangerous conditions. Avoid visiting flood-affected areas as a tourist. Do not spread rumours; rely on official information. Give additional assistance to children, older people, people who are bedridden, people with illnesses, and people with disabilities who may need help to evacuate. Keep important electrical and electronic equipment raised where possible to reduce flood-water damage. These are general preparedness points; follow the latest official alert for location-specific instructions.

documents.title: KSDMA Emergency Kit Guidance
documents.text: Emergency preparedness: KSDMA provides emergency-kit information through its official brochure collection. The KSDMA public-alert page lists items such as a torch, radio, drinking water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), necessary personal medicines, and basic antiseptic supplies. Prepare items appropriate to the needs of everyone in the household, including children, older adults, and people who need regular medication. Check official guidance and local instructions for the latest recommended kit contents.

documents.title: Orange Book of Disaster Management 2 - Monsoon Preparedness and Response Guidelines 2026
documents.text: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority lists the Orange Book of Disaster Management 2 - Monsoon Preparedness and Response Guidelines 2026 in its official guidelines catalogue. This record identifies the official guidance source; it does not reproduce the complete guideline. For operational decisions, consult the current Orange Book and the latest district or state instructions directly. Do not infer a current warning, evacuation order, shelter opening, or river level from this document index.
